What it solves (concretely)

  • Evidence for audit and regulation: a re-checkable certificate per money rule — anyone can verify it, forever, offline.
  • Safer releases: a money rule is either certified (proof attached) or declared — the ambiguity is removed, not guessed.
  • Protects the numbers: where the arithmetic is in fragment, decimal/scale exactness is proven; elsewhere it abstains instead of assuming.
  • Readies you for AI-written code: when code is generated or edited by AI, it can be required to produce these certificated rules or explicitly decline — a fail-closed control.

What we did not claim

  • Not a certificate of every line — only the rules we can prove, with the rest honestly labelled.
  • No source leaves your environment; the report carries counts, shapes and provenance only.
  • Every verdict is bound to a pinned authority (fingerprint below) and is re-checkable by anyone.
